buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1.0 Scope of Work 1.1 The Successful Bidder shall ensure that representative sampling is carried out strictly in acco rdance with the latest ISO / IS standard and other applicable ISO/BIS standards so that the coll ected sample truly represents the entire lot, rake, or stockpile or conveyor stream as per direc tion by Executives engineer/ In-charge. 1.2 The successful bidder shall carry out sampling from the rakes as per the directions of the Ex ecuting In-Charge for 167 rakes exclusively meant for sale, in accordance with the prescribed sampling procedure and applicable standards. 1.3 The Successful Bidder shall prepare and implement an approved sampling methodology cov ering sampling frequency, number of increments, minimum sample mass, sampling locations, sample reduction procedure and documentation to ensure unbiased, statistically valid and representative sampling. 1.4 The Contractor shall ensure that contamination; segregation, moisture loss/gain and materia l loss are prevented during sampling, handling, sample preparation, transportation and storag e to preserve the integrity and quality of the sample. 1.5 The Contractor shall carry out sample preparation, including crushing, mixing, homogenizati on, riffle splitting and sample reduction, strictly in accordance with applicable ISO/BIS standar

ds so that the laboratory sample accurately represents the original bulk sample. 1.6 The Successful Bidder shall maintain complete traceability of every sample by providing uniq ue sample identification, proper sealing, chain-of-custody records, field registers and all relate d documentation from sample collection to laboratory analysis. 1.7 The Contractor shall deploy qualified, experienced and competent technical personnel along with calibrated, well-maintained sampling and sample preparation equipment. Calibration cert ificates and maintenance records shall be maintained and produced to SAIL whenever require d. 1.8 The Contractor shall ensure that sampling is carried out in the presence of authorized SAIL r epresentatives whenever instructed, facilitate joint sampling, maintain complete transparency during the sampling process and immediately report any abnormality, deviation or non-confor mity observed at the site. 1.9 The Contractor shall ensure safe transportation of all collected samples from the sampling lo cation to the sample preparation facility and/or NABL-accredited laboratory in properly sealed, labeled and tamper-proof containers. The Contractor shall prevent contamination, segregation, spillage, moisture gain/loss and physical damage during transportation to mainta in sample integrity. 1.10 The Successful Bidder shall ensure that all chemical analysis of iron ore samples is carried o ut only through a NABL-accredited laboratory having valid accreditation for the required test p arameters and using the latest applicable ISO/BIS test methods. 1.11 The Contractor shall ensure that the laboratory maintains proper quality assurance/quality c ontrol (QA/QC), calibration of analytical instruments, use of Certified Reference Materials (CR Ms), and complete traceability of all analytical results. 1.12 The Successful Bidder shall submit authenticated test reports for all specified chemical para meters within the stipulated time, along with supporting QA/QC records, calibration certificate s and analytical data, whenever required by SAIL. 1.13 The Contractor shall ensure strict compliance with the Mines Act, DGMS guidelines, Mine Saf ety Rules, applicable statutory regulations and SAIL Safety Standards. All deployed personnel shall wear mandatory PPE, including safety helmet, safety shoes, reflective jacket, gloves, saf ety goggles and dust mask, and shall follow safe work practices while working near HEMM, co nveyors, stockyards, railway sidings and loading facilities. 1.14 The Contractor shall conduct site-specific risk assessment before commencement of work, o btain all necessary work permits, coordinate with the mine authorities, establish effective com munication and immediately suspend work in the event of unsafe conditions, adverse weather , equipment failure or any operational hazard. 1.15 The Successful Bidder shall be solely responsible for the accuracy, representativeness and re liability of the sampling process and shall rectify any non-conformity or repeat sampling, at no additional cost to SAIL, whenever the sampling is found to be non-compliant with the specified ISO/BIS standards, contractual requirements or instructions issued by SAIL. 1.16 The Successful Bidder shall ensure that representative sampling is carried out strictly in acco rdance with the latest ISO / IS standard and other applicable ISO/BIS standards so that the coll ected sample truly represents the entire lot, rake, or stockpile or conveyor stream as per direc tion by Executives engineer/ In-charge.
